criteria.evidence: internal/cli/defect.go requireMerged runs before the write, covers --brief and --blame; defect_test.go TestDefectAddRefusesUnmergedBrief asserts exit 1, empty stdout, exact suffix and no .vloop/defects.

criteria.criterion: When there is no default branch, it refuses with the error M-5's lookup gives today (`vloop: no default branch: origin/HEAD, main and master are all missing`), exit 1, writing nothing.
criteria.evidence: requireMerged returns runs.Release's DefaultBranch error; the test asserts the exact message, exit 1 and nothing written.

criteria.criterion: A merged brief is recorded exactly as before; found-by keeps its four values and stays required.
criteria.evidence: Only the requireMerged guard and the attribution echo order changed in defect.go; test records a merged brief with exit 0.
